title: 科技独涨数月后：市场风向变了？，广度扩大能持续吗
speaker: Viata Mante

segments.en: We do. We remain constructive, but it is ever-evolving equity markets, right?
segments.zh: 我们保持积极看法，但市场在持续演变。

segments.en: So a few months ago, we had this every narrow leadership that it was all right for the index level. However, not many parts of the market have done well as the tech and AI leadership has really crowded out everything else. And we see it changing going forward.
segments.zh: 几个月前，市场由少数科技和AI龙头主导，其他板块表现平平。但我们看到这一格局正在改变。

segments.en: For the last few weeks, you already had a sense of that. So the broadening has started. The question is, can it continue, right? And for that, you need some sense of macroeconomic stability.
segments.zh: 过去几周，市场广度已经开始扩大。问题是能否持续，这需要宏观经济的稳定。

segments.en: So for that, we look at the city economic surprise indices. They are picking up everywhere, especially in the cyclical markets. Of course, they went lower through the wall, right? Now, as the situation is improving, they are improving earnings provisions. So the direction of the analysts for us, this is improving meaningfully.
segments.zh: 我们关注花旗经济意外指数，全球各地都在回升，尤其是周期性市场。随着形势改善，盈利预期也在上调，分析师的方向明显向好。

segments.en: So they are quite an old or unusual thing happening in that, in that measure. So it's super broad. It's been positive for quite some time because tech and energy have been, upgrades have been so strong that the measure was strong, right? But now it's broadening again. So we see more sectors positively contributing.
segments.zh: 这个指标一直很强，因为科技和能源的盈利上调非常强劲。但现在广度再次扩大，更多行业在积极贡献。

segments.en: And also in Europe, in the US, in the pre-reporting season, usually you have down great, we are seeing upgrades now. So it's a good setup for that broadening to continue. Are we going to need to see a pullback in the big tech, though, to allow, as a catalyst to allow that broadening to happen?
segments.zh: 在欧洲和美国，财报季前通常会有下调，但现在我们看到上调。这为广度继续扩大创造了良好条件。但大型科技股是否需要回调来催化这一过程？

segments.en: We haven't already seen that. We've seen a bit of it.
segments.zh: 我们已经看到了一些回调。
